description: This file contains unit tests for the ElasticSearchIndexer class, specifically testing its methods for indexing, removing, creating, and handling Elasticsearch indices and documents within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: ElasticSearchIndexerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ElasticSearchIndexer, extending SearchTestAbstract, testing indexing, deletion, connection, and index management functionality.

methods.name: testGetModulesToIndex
methods.description: Tests retrieval of modules to index from ElasticSearchIndexer.

methods.name: testIndexBeans
methods.description: Tests indexing multiple beans and verifies counts of indexed, removed, and fields.

methods.name: testGettersAndSetters
methods.description: Verifies setter and getter methods for batch size and index name.

methods.name: testIndexBean
methods.description: Tests indexing a single bean.

methods.name: getTestBean
methods.description: Helper method to load a test bean from a JSON file.

methods.name: testMakeIndexParamsFromBean
methods.description: Tests creation of index parameters header and body from a bean.

methods.name: getExpectedHeader
methods.description: Provides expected header array for comparison in tests.

methods.name: getExpectedBody
methods.description: Provides expected body array for comparison in tests.

methods.name: testMakeIndexParamsBodyFromBean1
methods.description: Tests constructing index body from bean for default case.

methods.name: testMakeIndexParamsBodyFromBean2
methods.description: Tests constructing index body from bean with a documentifier.

methods.name: testRemoveBeans
methods.description: Tests bulk removal of beans from Elasticsearch.

methods.name: testRemoveBean
methods.description: Tests removal of a single bean from Elasticsearch.

methods.name: testMakeParamsHeaderFromBean
methods.description: Tests creation of header parameters for a bean.

methods.name: testRemoveIndex
methods.description: Tests index removal with a specified index name.

methods.description: Creates mock Elasticsearch client and indices namespace for testing.

methods.name: testRemoveIndex2

methods.description: Tests deletion of all indices in Elasticsearch.

methods.description: Tests Elasticsearch ping returning true.

methods.description: Tests creation of an Elasticsearch index with a mapping body.
